Initial release of the aihaoji skill for managing Ai好记 notes and notebooks.

- Supports searching, reading, exporting, managing, moving, and auto-classifying Ai好记 notes and notebooks via the official open platform API.
- Enforces strict source of IDs and data via live API queries—no guessing or use of local caches.
- Guides users on API key setup, validation, and troubleshooting.

- Comprehensive error handling and scenario-specific instructions provided for core user intents.
